_comment: Shapes for tests/unit/counters/test_counter_replacement_effects_only.py. t_ceo_season is Doubling Season's counter line, effects_only; t_ceo_walker is a planeswalker with a +1 and a +0 whose effect puts a loyalty counter on it, so a cost and an effect can be told apart on one permanent; t_ceo_hydra enters with two +1/+1 counters, one route a counter is given as a permanent arrives (riot, borrowed from riot.cards.json, is the other).

cards.name: Test Effect Season
cards.oracle_text: If an effect would put one or more counters on a permanent you control, it puts twice that many of those counters on that permanent instead.

abilities.text: If an effect would put one or more counters on a permanent you control, it puts twice that many of those counters on that permanent instead.

cards.name: Test Season Walker
cards.oracle_text:
+1: You gain 2 life.
+0: Put a loyalty counter on this planeswalker.

abilities.text: +0: Put a loyalty counter on this planeswalker.

cards.name: Test Season Hydra
cards.oracle_text: This creature enters with two +1/+1 counters on it.
